director.text: Hi Riya, main Asha, tumhari AI teacher hoon. Aaj cricket-pitch jaise shapes ka perimeter naapenge. Tumhe cricket mein batting pasand hai ya bowling?
samajh nahi aaya

Aaj hum kisi shape ke chaaron taraf ka poora kinaara naapenge. Cricket ki pitch socho, lagbhag 20 m lambi aur 3 m chaudi. Ek kone se chalo, kinaare-kinaare poori pitch ghoomo aur wapas wahin aa jao. Jitna chale, utna pitch ka parimap hai.
haan samajh gayi

Is triangle ki teen bhujayein hain, 4 cm, 5 cm aur 6 cm. Ek kone par ungli rakho aur kinaare par chalao: pehli bhuja, doosri, teesri, aur wapas usi kone par. Ungli jitna chali, wahi parimap hai. Is triangle ke kinaare ki poori lambai kitne cm hai?
director.card: Is triangle ke kinaare ki poori lambai kitne cm hai?

director.text: 9 cm

9 cm sahi nahi hai. Ise ek alag tareeke se dekhte hain. Ab ek khet socho, kone P, Q, R, S, T. P par ungli rakho aur har bhuja ka naam lo jaise-jaise uski lambai jodte ho. Ek bhi bhuja chhooti toh jod adhoora. Jod tabhi poora hota hai jab tum wapas P par pahunchte ho. Yahan tak saaf hai?

seams.form: Ise ek alag tareeke se dekhte hain.

director.text: thoda hindi mein samjhao

Theek hai, main yeh Hindi mein bolti hoon. Har bhuja par ungli rakho aur uska naam lo. Jo bhuja bol di, uski lambai jod do. Khet PQRST ki paanch bhujayein hain: PQ 8 m, QR 5 m, RS 7 m, ST 6 m, TP 3 m. Khet ka poora kinaara kitne metre ka hai?
director.card: Khet PQRST ki paanch bhujayein hain: PQ 8 m, QR 5 m, RS 7 m, ST 6 m, TP 3 m. Khet ka poora kinaara kitne metre ka hai?

director.text: 26 m nahi, yeh jawab theek nahi baitha. P se shuru karo aur PQ, QR, RS, ST, TP bolte jao. TP ke baad tum wapas P par ho. 8 m, 5 m, 7 m, 6 m aur 3 m bhujaon wale khet PQRST ka poora kinaara kitne metre ka hai?
director.card: Khet PQRST ki paanch bhujayein hain: PQ 8 m, QR 5 m, RS 7 m, ST 6 m, TP 3 m. Khet ka poora kinaara kitne metre ka hai?

director.text: 29 metre
Haan, sahi hai: P se wapas P tak paanchon bhujayein: 8 + 5 + 7 + 6 + 3 = 29 m. Achha, ab pehle wale sawaal ko phir se dekhte hain. Is triangle ke kinaare ki poori lambai kitne cm hai?
director.card: Is triangle ke kinaare ki poori lambai kitne cm hai?

seams.form: Achha, ab pehle wale sawaal ko phir se dekhte hain.

director.text: drawing karke samjhao

Triangle ki teeno bhujayein khol ke ek seedhi line par rakhi hain: 4 cm, 5 cm aur 6 cm, ek ke baad ek. Ungli ka poora safar yahi line hai. Is triangle ki bhujayein 4 cm, 5 cm aur 6 cm hain; iska parimap kitna hai?
director.card: Is triangle ke kinaare ki poori lambai kitne cm hai?

director.text: 9 cm
Nahi, yeh theek nahi hai. Is sawaal ka jawab 15 cm hai, kyunki 4 + 5 + 6 = 15 cm, teeno bhujayein judi, koi nahi chhooti. Yahan tak saaf hai?
pata nahi, aap batao
4 aur 5 se 9 hua, aur 9 mein 6 aur jodo toh 15 cm; 6 chhod dete toh sirf 9 cm, yaani kinaara adhoora. Yeh hissa saaf hua?
mujhe nahi pata

Yeh hexagon hai, chhah bhujaon wala. Sab bhujayein barabar hain, par label sirf ek par hai: 5 cm. Baaki par kuch likha nahi, phir bhi woh kinaare ka hissa hain. Parimap mein har bhuja aati hai, likhi ho ya na ho. Poore hexagon ka parimap kitna hua?
director.card: Poore hexagon ka parimap kitna hua?

director.text: mujhe khud try karne do
Haan, pehle tum try karo.
director.card: Poore hexagon ka parimap kitna hua?

director.text: 5 cm
5 cm sahi nahi hai. Har bhuja par 5 cm likha hua socho. Ab chhah baar 5 cm jodo. Poore hexagon ka parimap kitna hua?
director.card: Poore hexagon ka parimap kitna hua?

director.text: 30 centimetres

Haan, sahi hai: chhah bhujayein, har ek 5 cm ki: 6 × 5 = 30 cm. Ab yeh rectangle dekho, 6 cm lamba aur 4 cm chauda. Parimap ek dhaaga hai jo kinaare par chalta hai: upar 6, bagal ki bhuja 4, neeche 6, phir 4. Andar ki jagah area hai, woh bilkul alag cheez hai. Kinaare par ek baar dhaaga lapetna hai. Kitna dhaaga lagega?
director.card: Kinaare par ek baar dhaaga lapetna hai. Kitna dhaaga lagega?

director.text: mujhe lagta hai 20 cm

Bilkul sahi, kyunki dhaaga sirf kinaare par chalta hai: 6 + 4 + 6 + 4 = 20 cm. Phoolon ki ek kyari triangle jaisi hai, uski bhujayein 7 m, 9 m aur 12 m hain. Uske kinaare-kinaare ek baar baad lagani hai. Kitni lambi baad lagegi?
aapko virat pasand hai?
Main AI teacher hoon, isliye meri apni koi pasand nahi hoti. Tumhe Virat ke baare mein sabse achha kya lagta hai?
chauka

Achha, toh tumhe chauka sabse achha lagta hai. Toh ab hum wahin se aage badhte hain. Pehla kadam dekho. Baad kinaare par lagegi, toh teeno bhujayein jodni hain: P = 7 + 9 + 12, kyunki ek bhi bhuja chhooti toh baad mein wahan khaali jagah reh jaayegi. Yeh kadam samajh aaya?

seams.form: Toh ab hum wahin se aage badhte hain.

j2.line: Achha, toh tumhe chauka sabse achha lagta hai.

director.text: haan, samajh aaya
Pehle 7 aur 9 jodo: 7 + 9 = 16 m, kyunki do bhujayein ho gayi, teesri abhi baaki hai.
theek hai
Ab teesri bhuja bachi, 12 m. 16 mein 12 jodo, kitna hua?
director.card: Ab teesri bhuja bachi, 12 m. 16 mein 12 jodo, kitna hua?

director.text: pata nahi
16 m mein abhi sirf do bhujayein hain, 7 m aur 9 m. Teesri bhuja 12 m bhi kinaare par hai, use bhi jodna hai. 16 mein 12 jodo, kitna hua?
director.card: Ab teesri bhuja bachi, 12 m. 16 mein 12 jodo, kitna hua?

director.text: mujhe lagta hai 28 m

Haan, sahi hai: baad ko teeno bhujaon par chalna hai, ek bhi bhuja chhoot nahi sakti. Toh poora jawab: kyari ke liye 28 m baad lagegi. Ek park ki chaar bhujayein alag-alag lambai ki hain. Ek kone se ghoomo toh: 9 m, 6 m, 7 m aur 4 m. Usi kone par wapas pahunchne tak kitne metre chaloge?
director.card: Ek park ki chaar bhujayein alag-alag lambai ki hain. Ek kone se ghoomo toh: 9 m, 6 m, 7 m aur 4 m. Usi kone par wapas pahunchne tak kitne metre chaloge?

director.text: Bilkul sahi, kyunki chaaron bhujayein judti hain: 9 + 6 + 7 + 4 = 26 m. Zoya ne 10 cm lambe, 4 cm chaude card ka parimap 10 × 4 = 40 cm nikala. Sahi parimap kitne centimetre hai?
director.card: Zoya ne 10 cm lambe, 4 cm chaude card ka parimap 10 × 4 = 40 cm nikala. Sahi parimap kitne centimetre hai?

director.text: 40 cm

40 cm sahi nahi hai. Ek doosri tarah se samajhte hain. Kinaare par dhaaga lapeto, phir kholke scale par rakho: woh lambai parimap hai, cm mein. Andar tiles bichhao toh woh area hai. Parimap mein chaaron bhujayein jodte hain, guna nahi. Tumhare paas 140 cm ribbon hai. 14 cm lambe, 9 cm chaude sticker ke kinaare-kinaare ribbon lagao. Kitna bachega?
director.card: Tumhare paas 140 cm ribbon hai. 14 cm lambe, 9 cm chaude sticker ke kinaare-kinaare ribbon lagao. Kitna bachega?

seams.form: Ek doosri tarah se samajhte hain.

director.text: 94 cm

Haan, bilkul theek: kinaare par 14 + 9 + 14 + 9 = 46 cm lagega, toh 140 − 46 = 94 cm bachega. Theek hai, ab wapas usi sawaal par chalte hain. 10 cm lambe, 4 cm chaude card ka sahi parimap kitne centimetre hai?
director.card: Zoya ne 10 cm lambe, 4 cm chaude card ka parimap 10 × 4 = 40 cm nikala. Sahi parimap kitne centimetre hai?

seams.form: Theek hai, ab wapas usi sawaal par chalte hain.

director.text: 40 cm

Nahi, yeh theek nahi hai. Is sawaal ka jawab 28 cm hai, kyunki parimap kinaara hai: 10 + 4 + 10 + 4 = 28 cm; 10 × 4 andar ki jagah hai. Seedhi bhujaon wali har shape mein har bhuja jodna chalta hai. Ab ek rectangle socho: iski bhujayein jodiyon mein aati hain, aur isse jodne ka ek jaldi wala tareeka milta hai.
ab main jaati hoon, bye
Theek hai Riya, tum break lena chahti ho—main samajh gayi. Chuno: aage badhein, thodi der rukhein, ya aaj ke liye rok dein?
